correctness.rationale: Re-audited repairs/3/RESULT.md: rank-normalizing P by UPV⁻¹ takes X to VXU⁻¹ and intertwines XPX=0 by invertible maps. The four simultaneous block constraints and free bottom-right block agree with multiplication. A square-zero A of rank j is recoverable from im A⊆ker A and an isomorphism from the kernel quotient; the Gaussian choices and GL factor are correct. The projected B map of rank u admits q^(js) lifts, each forcing exactly j+u independent directions in ker C. This exhausts all matrices with no double counting. An independent incidence description cross-checks the stratification: for d=rank X and h=dim P(im X), choose im X by intersecting ker P in dimension d−h and projecting to dimension h in the rank-r quotient. There are [m−r choose d−h]_q [r choose h]_q q^(h(m−r−d+h)) choices. Choose ker X to contain P(im X) in [n−h choose d]_q ways, then the isomorphism k^n/ker X→im X in |GL_d| ways. The original equation in this parametrization is exactly P(im X)⊆ker X. These descriptions include rank zero, full-rank square and empty-block boundaries. For rank one the radical of the normalized ideal is generated by A and the products C_i B_j; after A is eliminated the ideal of those products is the intersection of the coordinate ideals (C_i) and (B_j). This proves the stated reduced geometry and its count over every field. The code was inspected, not executed; its finite cases are ancillary, and the repair does not change any predicted outputs.

evidence: The earlier three-block formula gives exactly q^((m−1)(n−1))(q^(m−1)+q^(n−1)−1) at rank one. The later-dated rank-two sandwich record has a rank-two point count and component classification. The pairwise-annihilation census counts tuples of mutually annihilating square matrices.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: These are covered or overlapping restricted families, not all-rank sandwich tables. In particular the rank-two classification should not be treated as disjoint, but its statement does not give a count for arbitrary r and its date does not establish priority for the general result.

originality.rationale: Original scope had included the rank-one locus and its point count as a contribution. Those are covered by an earlier three-block parabolic zero-product result, not merely similar dimensions. The replacement moves that case to a credited antecedent and limits the distinct claim to the arbitrary-rank fixed-sandwich census beyond covered specializations. No inspected stronger result gives that general census; a later rank-two count is a real partial catalogue overlap. This is a narrowing, not a pass on the original rank-one originality claim.
residual_risks: Older work on complexes, matrix equations, or Munn algebras could specialize to a stronger count; the statement comparison was bounded, not an exhaustive priority search.

value.rationale: Even without the covered rank-one result, the formula gives an exact natural nilpotent invariant for the same rectangular sandwich family whose idempotents are classically counted. It resolves how the intermediate sandwich rank and the off-diagonal restriction interact, across all dimensions and fields, rather than recomputing ordinary matrix nilpotence or one low-dimensional table.
